auth.quote: All permissions listed are Member Permissions (3-legged OAuth), meaning they require an authenticated LinkedIn member to grant consent
Applications must be authorized and authenticated before accessing LinkedIn data or member information.

access.quote: Vetted Product with development and standard tiers
All applications start with Development tier. You must apply separately to upgrade to the Standard tier.
Development tier is designed to build end-to-end workflows and supports read-only access for unlimited ad accounts and edit capabilities for up to five (5) Ad Accounts.
submit a tier upgrade request with a video demonstrating how your platform creates, edits, or optimizes LinkedIn campaigns.
LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion

api.quote: These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.

mcp.quote: Token generator: Generate a new token for testing using the Developer Portal.

buildability.quote: Apply to the desired API under the Products tab of your app.
Review our API and data restrictions to ensure your use case is supported and your application is not rejected due to a restricted use case.

uncertain.mcp: No vendor MCP found in LinkedIn/Microsoft Learn Marketing docs (the MCP evidence entry is only a docs-tools page, showing no MCP is listed); web search returned only third-party servers (PyPI linkedin-ads-mcp, danielpopamd, AdKit, Two Minute Reports, CData). The host mcp.linkedin.com resolves but sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (403 'Just a moment...'), so whether LinkedIn hosts an MCP there could not be determined; a human should check in a browser.
uncertain.access: Could be read as partner_gated: Advertising API is a 'Vetted Product' and LinkedIn 'reserves the right to ... select partners'. Chose approval_required because the Advertising API is a GA product 'open to all approved developers' via an application form, with a usable Development tier after approval.

notes: Creating an app requires a LinkedIn Page. Development tier: unlimited read, edit up to 5 ad accounts, 1 test ad account creatable via API; Standard tier via support ticket + demo video. Audience Insights / Media Planning APIs are restricted (additional criteria); Company Intelligence API closed to new applicants. Marketing API is versioned monthly (li-lms-2026-11).
